Compatibility, stated honestly.

The planner is tested in recent Firefox and Chromium-based browsers on desktop, and in mobile Safari and Chrome for everyday use. It runs from a local file or any static host — no installation, no account, no internet needed after download. Browser storage can be restricted in some contexts (for example pages opened directly as files); in that case the planner tells you and offers export instead of losing data. See the included BROWSER-SUPPORT.md for the full tested matrix.
